_source: brand/guidelines/Ritorica Brand Guidelines - Standalone.html (v1.0, 2026), unpacked with tools/extract_brand_bundle.py
name: Ritorica

logo.primary_note: Blue #4072D6 on white or tint. Default.
logo.reversed_note: White on brand blue or deep blue only.
logo.clear_space: Height of the 'R' on every side
rules: Never redraw, recolour, stretch or outline
Never on a photo without a solid panel behind it

colors.balance: Mostly white and tint, one strong block of blue, deep blue and navy as anchors (approx. 5 : 3 : 1.2 : 0.8)

chart_palette._rule: Blues do the work. Semantic colours only where they mean something. No native channel/app colours.

fonts.licence_note: Gilroy is licensed (self-hosted). Decision 2026-10-19: embed Gilroy in report PDFs (internal/investor distribution). If the licence turns out not to allow PDF embedding, switch display/body family to 'Manrope' (guideline fallback).

typography._note: Web scale from the guidelines, mapped to print points for an A4 report.

shape.shadow_rule: Soft and blue-tinted, never neutral grey

motif.name: Tilted key
motif.shape: Rounded square, corner radius 22% of width
motif.placement: Bleeding off corners and edges, behind content. Never a solid block over content.

icons.style: White line glyph on brand-blue rounded tile
icons.rule: Channel icons use the Ritorica tile, never native app colours

voice.summary: Plain, specific, calm. The engineer who has seen this problem before.
rules: Lead with the number; no hype, no exclamation marks
Every claim backed by a number or source
Explain how it works; don't push
Short sentences: two to four per paragraph, one idea each
voice.say: It isn't a discount. It's the order you send in.

do: Use real numbers; mark modelled ones as illustrative
dont: Native app colours for channel icons
Name competitors or show client logos without approval
exceptions: Competitor analysis reports: naming competitors approved by the brand owner (2026-10-19). Mark these reports 'Confidential — internal and investor use'.
